description: This source file defines a function to retrieve the current used CPU memory on Linux systems by parsing '/proc/self/status' for VmRSS and VmSwap entries.

methods.name: SearchForMemoryValue
methods.description: Searches for a specific memory value in the buffer by looking for a key and parsing the following number, returning the value in bytes.

methods.name: SbSystemGetUsedCPUMemory
methods.description: Reads '/proc/self/status', extracts VmRSS and VmSwap values, and returns their sum in bytes as the current used CPU memory.
